source: Built with TinyGo 0.44.0 `-opt z -gc=none` and run in QEMU (`mps2-an386`, Cortex-M4F) by `cmd/mcubench`, with BS-sourced bursts on every slot. CPU counts the cycles of the `rf` and `fsktx` code and of the bench loop per second of signal. RAM is the `Transmitter` or `AudioTransmitter` and the most stack under it. Flash is the code and constant data of the whole program.
